arc.title: Arc Browser detected
arc.description: Arc's WebRTC behaviour isn't compatible with other browsers. Please don't take the Host role (don't create a room, don't accept being made Host) — when Arc is Host, other Chrome / Firefox users may be unable to join OR to reconnect after a host transfer. Use Chrome, Firefox, or Safari to create rooms. If you can only join someone else's room, open arc://flags, search "Anonymize local IPs exposed to WebRTC", set it to Disabled, and restart Arc to reduce (but not fully eliminate) connection problems.
